content:
Looking for low-sodium alternatives to instant ramen, specifically the Nongshim/농심 bowls.
I've been really enjoying these ramen bowls because they're a perfect caloric amount for lunch and they're super easy prep wise. I cut my time as optimally as I can, oatmeal for breakfast, ramen for lunch, dinner is usually made by my partner so that's covered.

I'm looking for a similar situation, but with low-sodium. It can be anything as far as food goes, it just needs to be instant(or at the very least all I need to do is microwave the thing) and low in salt.
